plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Nursing – Registered, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 1501S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/nursing-department/nursing-registered/nursing-registered-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Science (page title 'Nursing – Registered, Associate of Science'; the program overview confirms the Associate of Science in Nursing, ASN). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 73, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 73'); semester tables print 16/15/14/14/14 and sum exactly. Modeled with the catalog's own five-block structure: 'Pre-Admission Program Requirements' as semester 1, then First through Fourth Semesters. Choice slots: 'MATH 143 College Algebra OR MATH 153 Statistical Reasoning' (both 3 cr); COMM GE / HUMA GE1 / HUMA GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Pre-admission also requires current CNA certification (not a course in this plan). Graduates are eligible for the NCLEX-RN. Footnote: Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
